improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon: a Claude-powered AI assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:site_name" content="GDN AI">
improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value prop (Claude-powered AI, trade/business focus, free trial, affordable pricing). Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. The copy stays factual, uses verified pricing, and highlights the free-trial hook to drive conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and professional guidance for your business operations. Try 3 free searches — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately names the product and clarifies its purpose, building trust and recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional guidance) while emphasizing the risk-free trial offer. The 'no credit card required' addition reduces friction and increases trial conversions. Copy is concise, benefit-driven, and avoids unverifiable claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join as a member. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace. Annual plans save you 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point—the paywall transition. By clearly explaining what happens next and immediately reinforcing the low entry price and value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), it reduces uncertainty and positions the paywall as an upgrade rather than a barrier. This builds trust and moves prospects toward conversion.
